description: Rewrites modal-request borrow + person-pronoun + concrete-object calques to lend + person-pronoun + concrete-object only at sentence end.
fp_risk_note: High risk. Borrow/lend direction is easy to reverse incorrectly. V1 only rewrites modal requests with Can/Could/Would/Will + you/he/she/they + borrow + person pronoun + determiner + whitelisted concrete object at sentence end. It blocks subject I, borrowed/borrows/borrowing, imperatives, embedded clauses, from-phrases, multi-clause tails, broad borrow/lend grammar, and non-whitelisted objects.

positive.input: Can you borrow me your pen?
positive.expectedCorrection: Can you lend me your pen?
positive.notes: Modal request with you + borrow + me + whitelisted concrete object.

positive.input: Could you borrow me a book?
positive.expectedCorrection: Could you lend me a book?
positive.notes: Could request with a whitelisted object.

positive.input: Can she borrow him her phone?
positive.expectedCorrection: Can she lend him her phone?
positive.notes: Third-person allowed subject with person pronoun and concrete object.

positive.input: Would they borrow us their charger?
positive.expectedCorrection: Would they lend us their charger?
positive.notes: They subject and charger object are allowed.

positive.input: Will he borrow her his notebook?
positive.expectedCorrection: Will he lend her his notebook?
positive.notes: Will request with he subject and notebook object.

negative.notes: Subject I is explicitly out of scope.

negative.input: Can I borrow a book from you?
negative.expectedCorrection: Can I borrow a book from you?

negative.input: Can you lend me your pen?
negative.expectedCorrection: Can you lend me your pen?

negative.notes: Past borrow is out of v1 scope.

negative.input: She borrowed a phone from him.
negative.expectedCorrection: She borrowed a phone from him.
negative.notes: Correct from-phrase and non-modal past form.

negative.input: Can you borrow me some money?
negative.expectedCorrection: Can you borrow me some money?
negative.notes: Money is not a whitelisted concrete object.

negative.input: Can you borrow me your idea?
negative.expectedCorrection: Can you borrow me your idea?
negative.notes: Idea is abstract and out of scope.

negative.input: I asked him to borrow me a book.
negative.expectedCorrection: I asked him to borrow me a book.
negative.notes: Embedded clause is out of scope.

negative.input: Can you borrow me your pen from him?
negative.expectedCorrection: Can you borrow me your pen from him?

negative.input: Can you borrow me your pen because I need it?
negative.expectedCorrection: Can you borrow me your pen because I need it?

negative.input: Can you borrow me your pen and your book?
negative.expectedCorrection: Can you borrow me your pen and your book?

negative.notes: Borrowed form is out of scope.
Declarative borrows form is out of scope.

negative.input: Can you borrowed me your pen?
negative.expectedCorrection: Can you borrowed me your pen?
negative.notes: Borrowed form must not be rewritten even inside a modal frame.

negative.input: Can you borrows me your pen?
negative.expectedCorrection: Can you borrows me your pen?
negative.notes: Borrows form must not be rewritten.

negative.input: Can you borrowing me your pen?
negative.expectedCorrection: Can you borrowing me your pen?
negative.notes: Borrowing form must not be rewritten.

negative.input: Can we borrow them their car?
negative.expectedCorrection: Can we borrow them their car?
negative.notes: Subject we is not allowed in v1.
